title: On potential Type II blowups for the Navier-Stokes equations
summary: In the present note, certain scenarios of potential Type II blowups of solutions to the Navier-Stokes equations are considered on the local level. They generalise particular scenarios described in the previous papers of the author. The main features of the approach, adopted in the note, are a zoom based on the Euler scaling and Liouville type theorems for the Euler equations in classes motived by a particular scenario of the Type II blowup.
